Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW portrait of Sir Trevor Gwyvern's Rhyfel stallion with a conspicuously cheeky, confrontational, aggressive personality. He must look like an ill-mannered powerful horse with attitude, not a calm polite horse merely painted another color.
Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Reference 1: ONLY the central horse's Rhyfel breed anatomy: medium-large robust cavalry stallion, broad chest, powerful arched neck, strong load-bearing back, sturdy muscular legs and modest fetlock feathering. Keep this recognizable Rhyfel build. Do not copy the riders, armor, flags, other horses or watercolor style.
Reference 2: ONLY actual Gwyvern heraldry, ivory-white wyvern with gold wing membranes and mane. ONE very small black saddle pennant with this wyvern and a narrow red edge, no tassels, pole or heavy frame. No other insignia.
Equipment: plain practical brown leather saddle and simple bridle, one ordinary girth, modest stirrups, small dull burgundy pad, loose reins. Sparse functional tack. No armor, elaborate straps, ornamental metal, saddle bags or cargo. The HORSE and his facial expression are the focus.
Full body, both ears, four anatomically correct legs and four hooves, whole tail inside the frame with breathing room. Make the head large and readable. ONE horse, no rider or people. Animal remains a horse: natural equine mouth and teeth, no human eyebrow, smile or hands, no predator fangs, no glowing eyes or fantasy mutations.
Background extremely restrained: a patch of grass and worn earth beside a plain low stone wall, distant blue sea and a soft sky, only a few large shapes. No castles, boats, busy vegetation or props. Clear daylight, crisp cel-shading. Portrait 1024x1536, 2:3, no text or collage.
Specific individual: Deep blackish seal-brown coat with warm dark brown muzzle, black coarse mane cut somewhat short but with a violently messy thick forelock, black tail, tiny irregular white forehead star. Thick bullish neck and powerful compact cavalry body, broad square head. Close confrontational three-quarter front view facing slightly left. Ears pinned sharply back, a flash of eye-white around a narrowed sideways eye, nostrils widely flared and wrinkled muzzle, tight lips, chin thrust toward the viewer: an unmistakable "move out of my way" challenge. Head lowered and neck arched, one front hoof lifted a few inches to scrape the ground impatiently, the other three hooves grounded. Tail flicking. His aggressive grumpiness should be striking and slightly funny through strong anime expression, not a serene handsome showhorse. Keep the full large horse legible, no dramatic rear or attack on anybody.
